headline: Flight Centre says hackers took passport and personal details of a large number of customers; if you have booked with Flight Centre, watch for scam messages.
summary: Flight Centre, an Australian travel company, says hackers got into an outside booking system and took customer details, including passport information. In the Gulf, the Houthis say they hit two Saudi ports on the Red Sea; Saudi Arabia says it shot down a drone near Jeddah and missiles aimed at Riyadh, with no oil sites reported damaged. No new attacks on US bases found since 21 November, and oil fell about 3% to US$92. Fire danger in the Hills is only Moderate, and Australian phones, banks and power are normal.
